def fourier (n : ℤ) : C(AddCircle T, ℂ) where

  continuous_toFun := continuous_induced_dom.comp <| continuous_toCircle.comp <| continuous_zsmul _

theorem fourier_apply {n : ℤ} {x : AddCircle T} : fourier n x = toCircle (n • x :) :=
  rfl

-- simp normal form is `fourier_coe_apply'`
theorem fourier_coe_apply {n : ℤ} {x : ℝ} :
    fourier n (x : AddCircle T) = Complex.exp (2 * π * Complex.I * n * x / T) := by
  rw [fourier_apply, ← QuotientAddGroup.mk_zsmul, toCircle, Function.Periodic.lift_coe,
    Circle.coe_exp, Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.ofReal_div, Complex.ofReal_mul, zsmul_eq_mul,
    Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.ofReal_intCast]
  norm_num
  congr 1; ring

@[simp]
theorem fourier_coe_apply' {n : ℤ} {x : ℝ} :
    toCircle (n • (x : AddCircle T) :) = Complex.exp (2 * π * Complex.I * n * x / T) := by
  rw [← fourier_apply]; exact fourier_coe_apply

  (hasDerivAt_exp x).differentiableAt.restrictScalars 𝕜

  Do NOT use directly. Use the coercion instead. -/
  toFun : E → F

instance instFunLike : FunLike 𝓢(E, F) E F where
  coe f := f.toFun

/-- All derivatives of a Schwartz function are rapidly decaying. -/
theorem decay (f : 𝓢(E, F)) (k n : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ x, ‖x‖ ^ k * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n f x‖ ≤ C := by
  rcases f.decay' k n with ⟨C, hC⟩
  exact ⟨max C 1, by positivity, fun x => (hC x).trans (le_max_left _ _)⟩

`‖x‖ ^ k * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n f x‖ ≤ c` holds.

Note that it is usually better to use `seminorm_le_bound` or `le_seminorm` instead of this lemma. -/
theorem seminorm_apply {k n : ℕ} (f : 𝓢(E, F)) : SchwartzMap.seminorm 𝕜 k n f =
    sInf { c | 0 ≤ c ∧ ∀ x, ‖x‖ ^ k * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n f x‖ ≤ c } := by rfl

/-- If one controls the seminorm for every `x`, then one controls the seminorm. -/
theorem seminorm_le_bound (k n : ℕ) (f : 𝓢(E, F)) {M : ℝ} (hMp : 0 ≤ M)
    (hM : ∀ x, ‖x‖ ^ k * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n f x‖ ≤ M) : SchwartzMap.seminorm 𝕜 k n f ≤ M :=
  f.seminormAux_le_bound k n hMp hM

/-- If one controls the seminorm for every `x`, then one controls the seminorm.

Variant for functions `𝓢(ℝ, F)`. -/
theorem seminorm_le_bound' (k n : ℕ) (f : 𝓢(ℝ, F)) {M : ℝ} (hMp : 0 ≤ M)
    (hM : ∀ x, |x| ^ k * ‖iteratedDeriv n f x‖ ≤ M) : SchwartzMap.seminorm 𝕜 k n f ≤ M := by

  simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv]

    ‖x‖ ^ k * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n f x‖ ≤ SchwartzMap.seminorm 𝕜 k n f :=
  f.le_seminormAux k n x

/-- The seminorm controls the Schwartz estimate for any fixed `x`.

Variant for functions `𝓢(ℝ, F)`. -/
theorem le_seminorm' (k n : ℕ) (f : 𝓢(ℝ, F)) (x : ℝ) :

  rwa [← Real.norm_eq_abs, ← norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv]

  simp only [one_pow, mul_one, Finset.sum_mul]

/-!
# Exact difference reciprocity on the original shared first factor

All arithmetic data are constructed from the original positive tuple and its
actual CRT compatibility. The proof combines the two divisibilities with common
`w₀`, then those with common `delta`; it allows `delta` and `w₀` to overlap.
The resulting three phases retain the signed difference quotient, the complete
root modulo `g*d₁`, and the slow denominator `N₁*L`.

The six public statements are finite identities. They include arbitrary signed

/-- Fourier transport retains every signed integer frequency and all three phases. -/
theorem sharedDifferenceReciprocity_fourier
    {p v w N₁ N₂ : ℕ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hv : 0 < v) (hw : 0 < w)
    (hN₁ : 0 < N₁) (hN₂ : 0 < N₂)
    (hc : ComplexCRT.Compatible (p * v) (p * w) N₁ N₂) (a h : ℤ) :
    let g := N₁.gcd N₂
    let D := v.gcd w
    let v₀ := v / D
    let w₀ := w / D
    let delta := p * D
    let d₁ := CanonicalReciprocalData.supportedPart (N₁ / g) g
    let n₁ := CanonicalReciprocalData.coprimePart (N₁ / g) g
    let n₂ := N₂ / g
    let A := g * d₁
    let L := (p * v).lcm (p * w)
    let f : ℤ := ((d₁ : ℤ) * n₁ - n₂) / (delta : ℤ)
    let t := CanonicalReciprocalPhase.wPhaseInverse (A * n₂ * v₀) (n₁ * w₀)
    let z := CanonicalReciprocalPhase.wPhaseInverse (n₁ * L) A
    let b := ComplexCRT.residue (p * v) (p * w) N₁ N₂ a
    fourier h (((b : ℝ) / (L : ℝ) : ℝ) : UnitAddCircle) =
      fourier h (((-(a : ℝ) * (z : ℝ) / (A : ℝ)) : ℝ) : UnitAddCircle) *
        fourier h ((((a : ℝ) / ((N₁ : ℝ) * L)) : ℝ) : UnitAddCircle) *
          fourier h (((((a : ℝ) * (f : ℝ) * (t : ℝ)) / ((n₁ : ℝ) * w₀)) : ℝ) : UnitAddCircle) := by
  have he := sharedDifferenceReciprocity_circle hp hv hw hN₁ hN₂ hc a
  dsimp only at he ⊢
  rw [he, SharedDifferenceReciprocity.fourier_add,
    SharedDifferenceReciprocity.fourier_add]

/-- The original shared-row Poisson frequency uses original `V`, literal cutoff and all h. -/
theorem MediumAtom.sharedFirstFactor_poissonFrequency_eq_differencePhases
    {B : ℕ} {sigma kappa c0 : ℝ} {d : MediumAtom}
    (hd : MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d) {p : ℕ}
    (hp : p ∈ d.primitiveFirstFactorCarrier)
    {l l' : (ℕ × ℕ) × ℕ}
    (hl : l ∈ d.sharedFirstFactorRows) (hl' : l' ∈ d.sharedFirstFactorRows)
    (hc : ComplexCRT.Compatible (p * (l.1.1 * l.1.2))
      (p * (l'.1.1 * l'.1.2)) l.2 l'.2) (h : ℤ) :
    let v := l.1.1 * l.1.2
    let w := l'.1.1 * l'.1.2
    let N₁ := l.2
    let N₂ := l'.2
    let a := d.residue
    let g := N₁.gcd N₂
    let D := v.gcd w
    let v₀ := v / D
    let w₀ := w / D
    let delta := p * D
    let d₁ := CanonicalReciprocalData.supportedPart (N₁ / g) g
    let n₁ := CanonicalReciprocalData.coprimePart (N₁ / g) g
    let n₂ := N₂ / g
    let A := g * d₁
    let L := (p * v).lcm (p * w)
    let f : ℤ := ((d₁ : ℤ) * n₁ - n₂) / (delta : ℤ)
    let t := CanonicalReciprocalPhase.wPhaseInverse (A * n₂ * v₀) (n₁ * w₀)
    let z := CanonicalReciprocalPhase.wPhaseInverse (n₁ * L) A
    let b := ComplexCRT.residue (p * v) (p * w) N₁ N₂ a
    CommonSmoothCutoff.poissonNonzeroFrequency
      (d.V / (L : ℝ)) ((b : ℝ) / (L : ℝ)) h =
      if h = 0 then 0 else
        (d.V / (L : ℝ)) •

          fourier h (((-(a : ℝ) * (z : ℝ) / (A : ℝ)) : ℝ) : UnitAddCircle) *
            fourier h ((((a : ℝ) / ((N₁ : ℝ) * L)) : ℝ) : UnitAddCircle) *
              fourier h (((((a : ℝ) * (f : ℝ) * (t : ℝ)) / ((n₁ : ℝ) * w₀)) : ℝ) : UnitAddCircle) := by
  have hpp : 0 < p := SharedDifferenceReciprocity.factor_pos hd.2.2.1
    (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).1
  have hleft := SharedDifferenceReciprocity.row_pos hd hl
  have hright := SharedDifferenceReciprocity.row_pos hd hl'
  have he := sharedDifferenceReciprocity_fourier hpp hleft.1 hright.1
    hleft.2 hright.2 hc d.residue h
  dsimp only at he ⊢
  unfold CommonSmoothCutoff.poissonNonzeroFrequency

medium proposition.  `scale` is the complete convolution product. -/
def MediumAdmissible (B : ℕ) (σ κ c0 : ℝ) (d : MediumAtom) : Prop :=
  1 ≤ d.U ∧ 1 ≤ d.V ∧ 1 ≤ d.Q1 ∧ 1 ≤ d.Q2 ∧ 1 ≤ d.Q3 ∧
  Real.exp (Real.exp 1) < d.scale ∧
  c0 * d.scale ≤ (d.residue.natAbs : ℝ) ∧
  (d.residue.natAbs : ℝ) ≤ d.scale ^ (1 + κ) ∧
  d.Q1 < d.U * d.scale ^ (-σ) ∧
  d.U ^ 2 * d.Q2 * d.Q3 ^ 2 < d.scale ^ (1 - 8 * σ) ∧
  (d.residue.natAbs : ℝ) ^ (7 / 32 : ℝ) * d.U * d.Q1 * d.Q2 ^ 5 * d.Q3 ^ 2 <
    d.scale ^ (2 - 15 * σ) ∧
  d.U ^ (1 + 2 * (7 / 32 : ℝ)) * d.Q1 *
      d.Q2 ^ (5 - 2 * (7 / 32 : ℝ)) * d.Q3 ^ (2 + 2 * (7 / 32 : ℝ)) <
    d.scale ^ (2 - 15 * σ) ∧
  (∀ n ∈ d.alphaCarrier, ‖d.alpha n‖ ≤ 1) ∧
  (∀ n ∈ d.alphaCarrier, d.alpha n ≠ 0 → ∀ p : ℕ,
